title: Περὶ παρρησίας — Philodemus, On Frank Criticism (PHerc. 1471); RU «О свободе речи»
author: Philodemus of Gadara (from Zeno of Sidon's lectures)
size: About 94 fragments plus 24 columns; est. 8–10k words (lacunose)
edition: Olivieri, Teubner 1914, public domain: https://archive.org/details/philodemiperipar00philuoft. Konstan et al. 1998 (improved text).
ru_evidence: ruwiki Филодем из Гадары lists Russian only for Oeconomicus (1969), On Poems V (1979) and the epigrams. Index Academicorum appeared in Respublica Literaria (2020–21). No Peri parrhesias found.
en_evidence: Konstan, Clay, Glad et al., Philodemus: On Frank Criticism (SBL 1998), per Open Library.
other_translations: Unknown, not checked in this sweep.
value: Unique evidence for therapeutic pedagogy in Epicurean communities (correction, confession). Central for parrhesia studies after Foucault, Pauline community ethics and Hellenistic psychology.
ai_feasibility: Low to medium. Fragmentary papyrus with heavy supplements; the public-domain Olivieri text is outdated. A papyrologist must check the readings.
pilot_unit: The continuous final columns Ia–XXIVb, about 3k words (estimate).
